note: Chosen once at character creation, locked for the run. mobHp/mobDmg scale enemy stats; loot adds to drop rarity bias and drop chance; xp/gold scale rewards. Hardcore is an independent flag layered on top.

levels.name: Tender
levels.desc: A gentler realm. Fewer teeth, leaner spoils.

levels.name: Tempered
levels.desc: The realm as it was forged. Balanced.

levels.name: Brutal
levels.desc: Harder hits, richer hauls. For the seasoned.

levels.name: Damascus
levels.desc: Folded steel and cruelty. Only the proven survive.

hardcore.name: Hardcore
hardcore.desc: One life. Death is permanent — but the dead drop far richer.
